inputs.text: Vertical medium close shot of the same adult Chinese woman seated at the wooden desk. She holds one portrait-oriented smartphone steadily at chest height with its matte rear shell and camera module facing the camera; the display faces her and is completely hidden. She suddenly notices a new incoming call, expressed only through her widened eyes and a slight lift of her chin. Her free hand rests beside the laptop. Same oval face, low ponytail, light blue shirt, charcoal blazer and thin silver necklace. Premium handcrafted 3D plush doll film, cool blue light beginning to warm. Exactly one woman and one phone, rear side only, no visible screen, no interface, no generated text.
